checks.name: fixed_selection
checks.evidence: Only app-rx-64k-v1 and app-rx-96k-v1 select 65536/98304; no numeric caller bound. Invalid types/names rejected before compiler output creation.

checks.name: manifest_authority
checks.evidence: Constructors receive explicit keyword profile; verifiers reconstruct and compare full typed JSON, never derive profile from manifest. Wrong/missing selection, changed limit and live flag are rejected.

checks.name: default_compatibility
checks.evidence: Default canary output and full manifest reproduce frozen diagnostic-commands-001 exactly. RX64 reproduction and RX96 build binaries equal historical 65456-byte binary. Default linker and live admission sources match regression-20261102-04 hashes.

checks.name: live_admission
checks.evidence: RX96 manifests have distinct -rx96 format and live_flashing_enabled false. Python live dispatcher exposes no RX96 verifier selection; three actual suffixed/tampered manifest attempts reject. Swift exact-byte catalog source is unchanged.

checks.name: bounds
checks.evidence: Both profiles preserve app allocation 0x200000 and raw plus 4096-rounded staging payload limit 0x25e000. Maximum RX96 ends XIP 0x043b3ea0 / physical 0x003b3ea0; erase-rounded end 0x003b4000 remains below allocation end 0x003eb000.

checks.name: real_boundaries
checks.evidence: Scoped tests actually invoke RV32 assembler/linker for 65536,65552,98304,98320 bytes under both profiles and inspect successful ELF memory size. Captured-source constructors exercise same sizes.

checks.name: executable_guards
checks.evidence: Linker differs only MEMORY LENGTH. Single file-backed RX segment, pinned entries, no allocated writable/NOBITS, relocations, GOT, TLS, constructors; nm undefined rejection remains. Actual ELF negative mutations cover writable PH/section, NOBITS and REL/RELA.

checks.name: stack_guard
checks.evidence: 512-byte static per-function maximum unchanged and 513 rejected. This is not cumulative stack safety.

checks.name: scope
checks.evidence: No runtime C/assembly, catalog, hardware, RAM sizing or external flash ownership changes supplied by this profile. Legacy 1MiB storage constructor continues its implicit default graphics bound.

caveats: The RX96 demonstration remains exactly the existing 65456-byte executable and OTA. Only synthetic fixtures cross 64KiB; no larger executable hardware readiness has been shown.
Already-catalogued identical bytes retain old eligibility; live-disabled refers to the new manifest/profile, not a ban on that preexisting image.
Constructors check exact source/container/hooks/size, not complete runtime machine-code semantics. Future larger binaries require their own compiler/native/OTA/lifecycle review.
The new test asserts section/PH guards but does not independently inject an unresolved symbol; compiler nm-u check was inspected and unchanged guard remains present.
No mutable app-tail reservation or dashboard/RAM reclamation is established.
